action_items.detail: Browser check assertion used lowercase text while the rendered copy begins with uppercase 'You'. The app rendered the required sentence; update the check assertion before retest.

checks.name: home-brand-navigation
checks.evidence: Rendered home hero with both exact taglines, Bengaluru eyebrow, wa.me/919482428467 CTA; mobile menu opened and navigated to /microgreens.

checks.criterion: Our Microgreens page presents exactly the requested 14 varieties with correct names, variety labels, Regular prices, G.Y.O.C. prices, and Signature Mix regular-only pricing

checks.evidence: Catalog rendered 14 product cards with all requested names; Signature Mix displayed ₹109 and ₹204 and regular-only note.

checks.criterion: Product cards support product-specific WhatsApp ordering with weight selection and pricing plan selection
checks.name: product-whatsapp-order-options
checks.evidence: Emerald Vital controls changed ₹79 to ₹149, then G.Y.O.C. ₹169/₹99; order href contained wa.me number, product, variety, weight, and plan.

checks.criterion: G.Y.O.C. page explains Grow Your Own Crop accurately and offers a custom variety request
